text:
maria: Quick sync: Starlark Systems EAP — they countersigned the NDA except for one telemetry clause. Legal flagged retention window. We need to: 1) finalize NDA redline, 2) land benchmark harness + dataset, 3) schedule hardware drop & lab kit, 4) define metrics + telemetry fields, 5) prep marketplace packaging notes for later. Can we triage?

kevin: I can take the bench harness and scripts. Do we have a canonical dataset and token distribution to match prod?

maria: Good Q. Use the 'llm-eval-smoke' subset (1k prompts) — Jia owns it. Target sequences: 256/1024/2048 distribution. We want throughput (tokens/s), p50/p95/p99 latencies, GPU util, and KV cache hit rates.

jia: I'll publish the dataset snapshot to the bench repo today and add a README with the exact run order. Use this runner: https://git.internal/redwood/bench/runner (private).

sam: For infra: we need kernel profiles for the Starlark card (FP16 + q4_0 path). Runtime: can you add a model variant label so we can auto-fallback to a smaller quantized variant if OOM?

kevin: Yes — I'll add args for --quantize-profile=q4_0 and --fallback=redwood-compact-v1 to the runner. Sample run:```bash
./run_bench.sh --model starlark-a1 --seq 1024 --concurrency 8 --profile q4_0 --trace out/starlark-a1-1024.json
```

partner_li: FYI from partner: hardware shipping ETA 2026-04-02 to our lab. They want bench results within 2 weeks of receipt. Also asked for a short runbook we can hand to their field engineers.

maria: Perfect. Logistics note: ops will coordinate receiving and rack access. @sam can you own lab run instructions (power, firmware, nvlink config)?

sam: On it. I'll draft a one-pager with steps and minimum firmware (v3.2.1) and nvlink topology. Will post by EOD.

jia: Telemetry schema — legal asked that we keep telemetry non-identifiable and retention limited to 90 days for preview. Proposed fields: model_name, bench_id, seq_len, tokens_generated, latency_ms_p50/p95/p99, gpu_util_pct, host_mem_mb, kv_cache_hits. No logs with raw prompts. Thoughts?

kevin: That sounds fine. We can emit a sanitized trace with prompt hashes only (sha256). Bench runner will redact prompt text and only include first 8 chars of hash in metadata.

maria: Legal also wants a checkbox for data deletion after EAP. We should offer a script to purge preview telemetry. Add to runbook and to bench CI artifact cleanup.

deploy-bot: [automation] bench/runner CI triggered for branch starlark-preview by kevin — job #482 queued.

kevin: CI will exercise perf smoke and upload traces to s3://redwood-eap-starlark/ci-traces. Will tag traces with bench_id and commit sha.

maria: Action items summary: kevin = bench harness + CI + redaction; jia = dataset snapshot + telemetry schema; sam = lab runbook + firmware/nvlink; maria = legal follow-up on NDA retention redline + coordinate schedule with partner. Aim to have an internal dry-run on 2026-04-05 and partner handoff on 2026-04-06.

partner_li: That timeline works for Starlark. We'll confirm shipping details and provide an on-site engineer contact (TBD).

maria: Thanks all. If anything blocks, flag in this thread OR DM me. We'll do a 30 min sync tomorrow if needed. :rocket:
